note: SoW 2 D3: a spend vault on Stellar testnet whose owner is an OpenZeppelin smart account controlled by a device passkey. The owner created the passkey in a browser (Safari) on https://a-identity.xyz/stellar?network=testnet; the page reported a platform passkey synced in Apple Passwords, so its private key is held by the owner's Apple Passwords and never reaches our systems. Every value below except the page-reported enrolment fields was read back off the ledger after the deploy. No owner action had happened when this record was written; the owner action is recorded separately.

route.note: The owner's own browser on the production origin. smart-account-kit, configured as src/lib/stellar/passkey.ts configures it, deployed the account through the relay (OpenZeppelin Channels paid the fee); POST /api/stellar/passkey/vault/deploy deployed and seeded the vault, signed by the hosted testnet signer GDZXSO4A..., which is the vault's operator and has no owner power.

smartAccount.note: One context rule (Default context, no policy, no expiry) holding exactly one signer: the device passkey as an External signer under our WebAuthn verifier instance. No Ed25519 or Delegated signer exists, so only a WebAuthn assertion from that passkey can authorize for this account. The public key and credential id are public data, already on the ledger.

enrolment.source: page-reported at registration, not on the ledger
enrolment.authenticator: platform authenticator, provider Apple Passwords (synced passkey), transports internal and hybrid, user verified
enrolment.note: BE says whether the passkey may sync to other devices of the same password manager, BS whether it is synced now. The recovery position the owner acknowledged before the vault deploy: docs/chains/stellar-passkey-recovery.mdx.

caveats: The ledger verifies a secp256r1 (P-256) signature against the public key above; it cannot tell a device authenticator from a key held in software. That this key lives in a device authenticator rests on the enrolment the owner performed on the page and on the recorded owner action, not on the ledger.
The enrolment fields are what the browser returned at registration and the page displayed; they are not written on the ledger.

Fees: the account deploy was fee-bumped by GCNJB6V5YIODDSSCWXZ2VOKMRPRVZ2V723RRQS6STXE6NWTGVOJY35CN (OpenZeppelin Channels); the vault deploy and its seed were paid by GDZXSO4A..., the hosted testnet signer and the vault's operator, which holds no owner power. The passkey holder paid no fee and holds no XLM.
Testnet. A reset (next scheduled 2026-12-16) deletes every id above; the archived envelopes in soroban/releases/tx-archive/stellar-testnet/ are what survive it.
